issues.issue: Did the Officer apply the correct equivalency test (Hill) in finding New York petit larceny equivalent to Criminal Code theft?
issues.applicant_position: The Officer did not identify which Hill test she applied or the essential elements of the New York offence before finding equivalence.
issues.result_quote: the Officer’s failure to consider the essential elements of the offence in New York led to an error on her part in applying the test for equivalency
